title: A Label Is Not a Type

scenes.tts: Light on one set of vagal sensory axons suppresses breathing in an anaesthetized mouse. Light on another set makes the animal breathe fast and shallow. We follow only the sensory axons here. If the vagus were one cable reporting that the body is stretched, both results could not happen. So what does each set report?
scenes.visual: One grey cable splits into a blue and a yellow strand, each with its light result.
scenes.narration: Light on one set of vagal sensory axons suppresses breathing in an anaesthetized mouse. Light on another set makes the animal breathe fast and shallow. We follow only the sensory axons here. If the vagus were one cable reporting that the body is stretched, both results could not happen. So what does each set report?

scenes.tts: Vagal sensory cell bodies sit in two ganglia at the base of the skull. To pick out one set, researchers use genetic access. In mice, a Cre driver puts a light-gated channel into neurons that carry one label. Light then drives only those axons. Two labels were P two R Y one and N P Y two R.

scenes.tts: The mice were under deep isoflurane, with the vagus exposed. Light on P two R Y one neurons suppressed breathing. Light on N P Y two R neurons produced rapid shallow breathing. Nerve recordings showed P two R Y one axons to be largely fast A fibres, and N P Y two R axons largely slow C fibres.

scenes.visual: Two sketch breathing traces with a light bar: one flattens, one speeds up and shrinks; fibre-class chips appear.
scenes.narration: The mice were under deep isoflurane, with the vagus exposed. Light on P2ry1 neurons suppressed breathing. Light on Npy2r neurons produced rapid shallow breathing. Nerve recordings showed P2ry1 axons to be largely fast A fibres, and Npy2r axons largely slow C fibres.

scenes.tts: Activating P two R Y one neurons recruited an airway defence: apnoea, closed vocal folds, swallowing and expiratory reflexes. Inflation is a second way to stop breathing. In the Hering Breuer reflex, a filling lung interrupts further inspiration. In mouse ganglion imaging, most stretch-responsive neurons were Piezo two positive and P two R Y one negative.
scenes.caption: Activating P2ry1 neurons recruited an airway defence: apnoea, closed vocal folds, swallowing and expiratory reflexes. Inflation is a second way to stop breathing. In the Hering-Breuer reflex, a filling lung interrupts further inspiration. In mouse ganglion imaging, most stretch-responsive neurons were PIEZO2-positive and P2RY1-negative.
scenes.visual: Two circuit boxes, protection and stretch, with excitatory arrows into one red box: inspiration halts.
scenes.narration: Activating P2ry1 neurons recruited an airway defence: apnoea, closed vocal folds, swallowing and expiratory reflexes. Inflation is a second way to stop breathing. In the Hering-Breuer reflex, a filling lung interrupts further inspiration. In mouse ganglion imaging, most stretch-responsive neurons were PIEZO2-positive and P2RY1-negative.

scenes.tts: Light is a test of sufficiency in anaesthetized mice. It shows what cells can do when driven, not what drives them in life. A receptor gene used as a label is not thereby the molecule that senses. And one type, N P nineteen, was only a candidate for the defence reflexes.

scenes.visual: Three panels: light drives a cell vs what drives it in life; label vs sensor; cluster candidate.
scenes.narration: Light is a test of sufficiency in anaesthetized mice. It shows what cells can do when driven, not what drives them in life. A receptor gene used as a label is not thereby the molecule that senses. And one type, NP19, was only a candidate for the defence reflexes.

scenes.tts: So the vagus is not one cable. It holds sensory axons of many types, and some of them have been tied to different jobs. Atlases give different counts of types, because their scope differs. Keep the rule. A label is a handle. A type is a hypothesis about function, until genetic access, physiology or behaviour ties it to one.
